dialogues.jp: 「……さくら」
dialogues.en: "Sakura..."
dialogues.text: "Sakura..."

dialogues.jp: そういえばあいつ、今日はやけに不安定だった。
dialogues.en: She looked very down today when I think about it.
dialogues.text: She looked very down today when I think about it.

dialogues.jp:
あの時、無理にでも引き止めてベッドに押し込
んでおけば……。
dialogues.en: I should have forced her to stay in my bed.
dialogues.text: I should have forced her to stay in my bed.

dialogues.jp: 「……いや、なんか言葉が卑猥だが違うぞ」
dialogues.en: "It sounds obscene, but it's not."
dialogues.text: "It sounds obscene, but it's not."

dialogues.jp: 頭を振って窓の外を見る。
dialogues.en: I look outside the window shaking my head.
dialogues.text: I look outside the window shaking my head.

dialogues.jp:
さくらの家に変化は見られないが、もちろん屋
根を見ただけで、あいつの寝顔を確認したわけ
じゃない。
dialogues.en:
Her house still looks normal, but I don't know about her,
because I can only see the roof, not her face.
dialogues.text:
Her house still looks normal, but I don't know about her,
because I can only see the roof, not her face.

dialogues.jp: 「……かったりぃな」
dialogues.en: "Oh, what a pain in the neck..."
dialogues.text: "Oh, what a pain in the neck..."

dialogues.jp: ベッドから降りて、制服の上着を羽織る。
dialogues.en: I put on my uniform jacket and get out of bed.
dialogues.text: I put on my uniform jacket and get out of bed.

dialogues.jp:
音夢の部屋を確認してもよかったのだが、どう
してもさくらが気になる。
dialogues.en:
I could have checked Nemu's room, but I'm still worried
about Sakura.
dialogues.text:
I could have checked Nemu's room, but I'm still worried
about Sakura.

dialogues.jp: まだ冷え込みが残る明け方の外気。
dialogues.en: The air is chilly at dawn.
dialogues.text: The air is chilly at dawn.

dialogues.jp: かすかに東の空が明るくなっていた。
dialogues.en: I can see light in the east of the sky.
dialogues.text: I can see light in the east of the sky.

dialogues.jp: 街はまだ眠っている。
dialogues.en: The town is still quiet.
dialogues.text: The town is still quiet.

dialogues.jp: 今、何時だろう。
dialogues.en: I wonder what time it is.
dialogues.text: I wonder what time it is.

dialogues.jp:
そんなことを考えつつ、さくらの家の門をくぐ
る。
dialogues.en: I pass the gate to Sakura's house thinking like that.
dialogues.text: I pass the gate to Sakura's house thinking like that.

dialogues.jp: さすがに戸は閉まっていたので庭にまわる。
dialogues.en:
As I expected, the door was locked, so I go around to the
yard.
dialogues.text:
As I expected, the door was locked, so I go around to the
yard.

dialogues.jp:
俺の部屋に伸びる桜を見つめながら、ぐるり、
とさくらの部屋の縁側に――。
dialogues.en:
Looking at the cherry tree growing toward my room, I walk
around to the porch next to her room.
dialogues.text:
Looking at the cherry tree growing toward my room, I walk
around to the porch next to her room.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「っ……ひっく……」
小さなむせび泣きが耳を打つ。
dialogues.en: I hear a sob.
dialogues.text: I hear a sob.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ダメ……なんで……ここまで我慢してたのに
　……」
dialogues.en: "No... why? I've been patient until now..."
dialogues.text: "No... why? I've been patient until now..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あんな夢を見るから……音夢ちゃんが……こ
　れじゃあボクの存在はまるで……」
dialogues.en:
"Since Nemu-chan had a dream like that... This was my whole
existence..."
dialogues.text:
"Since Nemu-chan had a dream like that... This was my whole
existence..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「さくら？」
dialogues.en: "Sakura?"
dialogues.text: "Sakura?"

dialogues.jp: 暗がりの中で小さな影が動く。
dialogues.en: A tiny shadow moves in the darkness.
dialogues.text: A tiny shadow moves in the darkness.

dialogues.jp: 正直、ほっとした。
dialogues.en: To be honest, I feel relieved.
dialogues.text: To be honest, I feel relieved.

dialogues.jp: あいつが泣いてるときに来れてよかった。
dialogues.en: I am glad that I came here when she was crying.
dialogues.text: I am glad that I came here when she was crying.

dialogues.jp:
音夢みたいに分かりやすいやつじゃないから、
朝になったらもう、分からなかっただろうから
……。
dialogues.en:
Because she's not like Nemu who remembers everything next
morning.
dialogues.text:
Because she's not like Nemu who remembers everything next
morning.

dialogues.jp: 「泣いてるよなお前」
dialogues.en: "You're really crying."
dialogues.text: "You're really crying."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「っす……なんで、お兄ちゃんココに……？」
dialogues.en: "Uh, why are you here, oniichan?"
dialogues.text: "Uh, why are you here, oniichan?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そりゃ……」
dialogues.en: "Because..."
dialogues.text: "Because..."

dialogues.jp: さっきまで夢に見ていた縁側に手をつく。
dialogues.en: I put the hands on the porch that was in my dream earlier.
dialogues.text: I put the hands on the porch that was in my dream earlier.

dialogues.jp:
「お前の泣き声がうるさくて、眠れなかったん
　だよ」
dialogues.en: "I couldn't sleep because I heard you crying."
dialogues.text: "I couldn't sleep because I heard you crying."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「にゃ？」
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「こいよ、月がきれいだ……見事な満月……っ
　てわけにはいかないけどな」
dialogues.en:
"Come outside and see the moon. It's not a full moon yet,
but it's beautiful."
dialogues.text:
"Come outside and see the moon. It's not a full moon yet,
but it's beautiful."

dialogues.jp: 縁側に座って空を見上げた。
dialogues.en: I sit on the porch and look up at the sky.
dialogues.text: I sit on the porch and look up at the sky.

dialogues.jp:
薄っぺらい三日月が、空の笑顔のように張り付
いている。
dialogues.en: The crescent moon is smiling in the sky.
dialogues.text: The crescent moon is smiling in the sky.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ、来ないのか？」
dialogues.en: "Don't you want to come outside?"
dialogues.text: "Don't you want to come outside?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……涙で顔がぐちょぐちょだから嫌だ」
dialogues.en: "My face is messed up with tears."
dialogues.text: "My face is messed up with tears."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そうか。まぁ、そこにいてもいいや」
dialogues.en: "I see. Then, you stay there."
dialogues.text: "I see. Then, you stay there."

dialogues.jp: 小さく笑って頷く。
dialogues.en: I nod with a smile.
dialogues.text: I nod with a smile.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「本当にボクの泣き声が聞こえたの？」
dialogues.en: "Are you sure you heard me crying?"
dialogues.text: "Are you sure you heard me crying?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「音夢ちゃんじゃなくて？」
dialogues.en: "Wasn't it Nemu-chan?"
dialogues.text: "Wasn't it Nemu-chan?"

dialogues.jp: ざざ、と畳をこする音。
dialogues.en: The sound of a squeak against the tatami mat.
dialogues.text: The sound of a squeak against the tatami mat.

dialogues.jp: 「なんで音夢が出てくるんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Why did you bring up Nemu now?"
dialogues.text: "Why did you bring up Nemu now?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「普通お兄ちゃんの部屋で聞こえる声って、音
　夢ちゃんのものだと思うけど」
dialogues.en:
"When you hear something in your room, it must be usually
Nemu-chan, right?"
dialogues.text:
"When you hear something in your room, it must be usually
Nemu-chan, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「それもそうだな」
dialogues.en: "You're right."
dialogues.text: "You're right."

dialogues.jp: ははは、と自分でも可笑しかった。
dialogues.en: I laughed at myself.
dialogues.text: I laughed at myself.

dialogues.jp: 「なんとなく、お前のような気がしてさ」
dialogues.en: "For some reason, I thought it was you."
dialogues.text: "For some reason, I thought it was you."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「笑い事じゃないよそれ……」
dialogues.en: "It's not a laughing matter."
dialogues.text: "It's not a laughing matter."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「でも、お前が泣いてたから当たりだろ」
dialogues.en: "But I was right since you were crying."
dialogues.text: "But I was right since you were crying."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そうだけどさぁ」
dialogues.en: "Well, that's true."
dialogues.text: "Well, that's true."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Haha..."
dialogues.text: "Haha..."

dialogues.jp: 手を軽く握って開く。
dialogues.en: I squeeze my hands and open again.
dialogues.text: I squeeze my hands and open again.

dialogues.jp: 「なにかお菓子を食べたいかさくら？」
dialogues.en: "Do you want to eat a snack, Sakura?"
dialogues.text: "Do you want to eat a snack, Sakura?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
こんぺいとうを作って、夜空にかざして星と重
ねる。
dialogues.en:
I made a star-shaped candy, then held it up to overlap a
real star in the night sky.
dialogues.text:
I made a star-shaped candy, then held it up to overlap a
real star in the night sky.

dialogues.jp:
「いや、これってさ、すげーくだらない｛・・／魔法｝だ
　と思ってたんだよ」
dialogues.en: "Well, I completely believe this is a ridiculous magic."
dialogues.text: "Well, I completely believe this is a ridiculous magic."

dialogues.jp:
ぽんぽん、と饅頭やかりんとうなんかを並べて
いく。
dialogues.en:
I lay down a steamed bean-jam bun, a sweet pretzel and few
more things.
dialogues.text:
I lay down a steamed bean-jam bun, a sweet pretzel and few
more things.

dialogues.jp:
「和菓子を出せたって、基本的に食べるって以
　外に使い道ないだろう？」
dialogues.en:
"Even if I can make Japanese snacks appear, all you do is
eat them up."
dialogues.text:
"Even if I can make Japanese snacks appear, all you do is
eat them up."

dialogues.jp:
「ばあちゃんが他にも魔法を見せてくれたら、
　それも使えるようになっていたのかも知れな
　いけどさ」
dialogues.en:
"If grandma showed me a different magic other than that, I
could've been using it."
dialogues.text:
"If grandma showed me a different magic other than that, I
could've been using it."

dialogues.jp:
「でもさ……これはこれで、初めて悪くないっ
　て思ったよ」
dialogues.en:
"But to be honest, for the first time I thought this isn't a
bad power."
dialogues.text:
"But to be honest, for the first time I thought this isn't a
bad power."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Why?"
dialogues.text: "Why?"

dialogues.jp: 随分と落ち着きを取り戻した声が響いた。
dialogues.en: Her voice sounds calm now.
dialogues.text: Her voice sounds calm now.

dialogues.jp:
「いや、だってさ、泣いてるやつを笑わせられ
　るんだぜ」
dialogues.en: "Well, because it can stop a crying child from crying."
dialogues.text: "Well, because it can stop a crying child from crying."

dialogues.jp:
調子が良くて、ぽんぽん、と和菓子を生み出し
ていく。
dialogues.en: I create many Japanese snacks, one after another.
dialogues.text: I create many Japanese snacks, one after another.

dialogues.jp:
「モノを壊すとかさ、瞬間移動とかもかっこい
　いけどさ、これって他人のためにしか使えねぇ
　だろ？」
dialogues.en:
"Magic that can break things or make things move is cool,
but this magic is only to make other people happy, right?"
dialogues.text:
"Magic that can break things or make things move is cool,
but this magic is only to make other people happy, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Me?"
dialogues.text: "Me?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「泣いてる子を笑わせるって……ボクのために
　その力って使えるようになったのかな？」
dialogues.en:
"Make a crying child smile... Do you use the magic only for
me?"
dialogues.text:
"Make a crying child smile... Do you use the magic only for
me?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「え……あ、そうだな……」
dialogues.en: "Um...Uh...well..."
dialogues.text: "Um...Uh...well..."

dialogues.jp:
もうひとり、あの頃に泣き虫だったやつはいた
けれど。
dialogues.en: I know there was one other person who was a crybaby.
dialogues.text: I know there was one other person who was a crybaby.

dialogues.jp:
「音夢には内緒にしてたし、この力を普通に使っ
　てるのはお前にだけだな」
dialogues.en:
"I haven't told Nemu about this, so I use this only for you
so far."
dialogues.text:
"I haven't told Nemu about this, so I use this only for you
so far."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そっか」
dialogues.en: "I see."
dialogues.text: "I see."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「よく考えたらな」
dialogues.en: "When I think about it..."
dialogues.text: "When I think about it..."

dialogues.jp: 指をこすり合わせて、夜桜に目を向ける。
dialogues.en:
I look at the cherry blossoms at night, rubbing my fingers
together.
dialogues.text:
I look at the cherry blossoms at night, rubbing my fingers
together.

dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ、さっきのはやっぱり、さくらの夢だっ
　たのか」
dialogues.en: "Aahh, it was Sakura's dream, wasn't it?"
dialogues.text: "Aahh, it was Sakura's dream, wasn't it?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ぅにゃ！？」
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.jp: 暗闇の中からさくらが姿を現す。
dialogues.en: Sakura suddenly appears in the darkness.
dialogues.text: Sakura suddenly appears in the darkness.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「み、みゃ、み、見たの！？」
dialogues.en: "Di-du-did you see it?"
dialogues.text: "Di-du-did you see it?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「見たぞ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, I did."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, I did."

dialogues.jp: その前に、みゃ、ってなんだ。
dialogues.en: What is 'du', anyway?
dialogues.text: What is 'du', anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ！　うにゃにゃにゃにゃにゃにゃ！」
dialogues.en: "Hmmma! Waaaaaahhh!"
dialogues.text: "Hmmma! Waaaaaahhh!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……なんだよ」
dialogues.en: "What is it?"
dialogues.text: "What is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「人の夢を見るなんてプライバシーの侵害だぁ！
　訴訟国家をなめるなよ！」
dialogues.en:
"Seeing other people's dreams is an invasion of privacy!
Don't underestimate a litigious country!"
dialogues.text:
"Seeing other people's dreams is an invasion of privacy!
Don't underestimate a litigious country!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なんだそれは」
dialogues.en: "What are you talking about?"
dialogues.text: "What are you talking about?"

dialogues.jp:
掴みかかろうとするさくらから逃げるように立
ち上がって、桜の舞う庭に立つ。
dialogues.en:
I run away from Sakura, who looks like she's about to attack
me, and stand in the yard under the cherry blossom trees.
dialogues.text:
I run away from Sakura, who looks like she's about to attack
me, and stand in the yard under the cherry blossom trees.

dialogues.jp: 「懐かしい夢だったな」
dialogues.en: "The dream made me feel nostalgic."
dialogues.text: "The dream made me feel nostalgic."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「恥ずかしいよぉ」
dialogues.en: "It's embarrassing."
dialogues.text: "It's embarrassing."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「俺は嬉しかったぞ」
dialogues.en: "I liked it, though."
dialogues.text: "I liked it, though."

dialogues.jp:
まるで熱に浮かされるように、夢見ごこちに言
葉がこぼれてくる。
dialogues.en: I keep talking dreamily, as if I were delirious with fever.
dialogues.text: I keep talking dreamily, as if I were delirious with fever.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ〜」

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「はははは」
dialogues.en: "Hahahaha."
dialogues.text: "Hahahaha."

dialogues.jp:
月と桜の魔力なのか、なんだか、さくらの一挙
動が可愛く見え――。
dialogues.en:
It might be the power of the moon or the cherry blossoms,
but I start to see Sakura as adorable in every way.
dialogues.text:
It might be the power of the moon or the cherry blossoms,
but I start to see Sakura as adorable in every way.

dialogues.en: "Hahaha...?"
dialogues.text: "Hahaha...?"

dialogues.jp: ドクン。
dialogues.en: Throb.
dialogues.text: Throb.

dialogues.jp: 鼓動が大きく跳ねる。
dialogues.en: I feel my pulse quicken.
dialogues.text: I feel my pulse quicken.

dialogues.en: "Ahhh..."
dialogues.text: "Ahhh..."

dialogues.jp: 胸にヒビが入ったような鋭い痛みが襲ってくる。
dialogues.en: A sharp pain runs through my chest.
dialogues.text: A sharp pain runs through my chest.

dialogues.jp: ばっ、とさくらが胸元を押さえてうずくまる。
dialogues.en: Sakura bends over, touching her chest.
dialogues.text: Sakura bends over, touching her chest.

dialogues.jp: 「ど、どうした？」
dialogues.en: "What happened?"
dialogues.text: "What happened?"

dialogues.jp:
一瞬の痛みではあったが、このまま死んでしま
うのではという怖さに汗をかいていた。
dialogues.en:
I start to sweat with fear, thinking I might die of this
momentary pain.
dialogues.text:
I start to sweat with fear, thinking I might die of this
momentary pain.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃん、音夢ちゃん大丈夫！？」
dialogues.en: "Is Nemu-chan okay, oniichan?"
dialogues.text: "Is Nemu-chan okay, oniichan?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「え？　音夢？」
dialogues.en: "What? Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "What? Nemu?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「Ｈｕｒｒｙ！　早く見に行って！！」
dialogues.en: "Hurry! Go check her now!"
dialogues.text: "Hurry! Go check her now!"

dialogues.jp: さくらがなにを焦っているのか分からない。
dialogues.en: I have no idea why Sakura is so upset.
dialogues.text: I have no idea why Sakura is so upset.

dialogues.jp:
ただ、今は――この夜だけは、なにが起こって
も不思議でない気がした。
dialogues.en:
But right now, just in this moment, I know anything could
happen.
dialogues.text:
But right now, just in this moment, I know anything could
happen.

dialogues.jp: 「分かった」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp:
青い顔をしたさくらも心配だったが、俺は自分
の家を見上げてから音夢の部屋へと急いだ。
dialogues.en:
I'm worried about Sakura, who's looking pale, but anyway, I
rushed over to Nemu's room in my house.
dialogues.text:
I'm worried about Sakura, who's looking pale, but anyway, I
rushed over to Nemu's room in my house.

dialogues.jp: ◆泣き虫さくら◆
dialogues.en: ◆Crybaby Sakura◆
dialogues.text: ◆Crybaby Sakura◆

dialogues.jp:
さくらがひとりで泣いているような気がして、
面倒だったが隣の家に向かう。
dialogues.en:
I felt like Sakura was crying on her own, so I walked over
to next door, even thought I was tired.
dialogues.text:
I felt like Sakura was crying on her own, so I walked over
to next door, even thought I was tired.

dialogues.jp:
なぜか本当に泣いていたさくらを慰め、話をし
ているうちに、自分の和菓子を出す力がさくら
の涙を止める為のモノのような気がしてきた。
dialogues.en:
As I talked to her trying to calm her down, I started to
think my magic that makes snacks could have been given to me
so that I could stop her from crying.
dialogues.text:
As I talked to her trying to calm her down, I started to
think my magic that makes snacks could have been given to me
so that I could stop her from crying.

dialogues.jp:
そして、落ち着きを取り戻したさくらから、今
度は音夢ちゃんが泣いているかも知れないとい
う言葉を聞き、慌てて家に引き返した。
dialogues.en:
Then Sakura told me that Nemu might be crying, so I rushed
back to my house.
dialogues.text:
Then Sakura told me that Nemu might be crying, so I rushed
back to my house.
